BiblicalUsage: This is the same word for a bird's pinion as the masculine form, and its most tender use is in the song of Moses. As an eagle stirs up her nest and flutters over her young, spreading her wings to carry them, so God carried Israel. The psalms take the picture further, hiding us under His feathers and beneath His wings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's strength is a shelter before it is a weapon, because He spreads His wings over His people before He lifts them. I would rather be under those wings than anywhere else.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
